packages.label: נְקֻדָּה וְיוּד — הַצַּדִּיק, הַחָכְמָה, וְהַפֶּה
packages.label_en: The Point and the Yud — The Tzaddik, Wisdom, and the Mouth
packages.reason: All nodes in this component share the essential nature of the concentrated, seminal point of divine wisdom — the yud, the spring, the source. חכמה IS a bechina of נקדה ('חָכְמָה הִיא בְּחִינַת נְקֻדָּה'). נקדה IS a bechina of יוד ('נְקֻדָּה, הַיְנוּ יוּד'). מעין IS a bechina of יוד ('חָכְמָה הִיא בְּחִינַת נְקֻדָּה, הַיְנוּ יוּד, מַעְיָן'). צדיק IS a bechina of יוד ('צַדִּיק הוּא יוּד, כִּי הַצַּדִּיקִים הֵם נִקְרָאִים חַכְמֵי הָעֵדָה'). תורה IS a bechina of יוד ('הַתּוֹרָה הִיא יוּד, שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה'). עשרת הדברות IS a bechina of יוד (the Ten Commandments with the Tablets = מלאפום, the Ten Commandments themselves = the yud). פה IS a bechina of יוד ('יוּד, עַל-שֵׁם הַפֶּה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת'). 'פי ידבר חכמות' IS a bechina of נקדה (the point illuminating from the mouth-wisdom). לולב IS a bechina of צדיק ('הַלּוּלָב, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת צַדִּיק כַּיָּדוּעַ, בְּחִינַת: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח'). The essential shared nature: all are expressions of the seminal, concentrated divine point — the source of wisdom, speech, and leadership. The tzaddik is this point for all of Israel; Torah is this point in the domain of divine will; the mouth is this point in the human body; the yud is this point in the alphabet.

packages.label: וָאו וְלֵב — יִשְׂרָאֵל, הַבִּינָה, וְהַלּוּחוֹת
packages.label_en: The Vav and the Heart — Israel, Binah, and the Tablets
packages.reason: All nodes in this component share the essential nature of the extended, receptive vessel — the vav, the stream, the heart. בינה IS a bechina of וא"ו ('וּבִינָה הוּא נַחַל הַנִּמְשָׁךְ מִן הַמַּעְיָן. וְעַל-שֵׁם הַמַּשְׁכוּת, הוּא וָאו'). הלוחות IS a bechina of וא"ו ('הַלּוּחוֹת אָרְכָּן שִׁשָּׁה וְרָחְבָּן שִׁשָּׁה' — they are the vav). העולם IS a bechina of וא"ו ('הָעוֹלָם נִבְרָא בְּשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה' — six days = vav). ווי העמודים IS a bechina of וא"ו (they are literally named after the letter). ישראל IS a bechina of וא"ו ('יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵם בְּחִינַת וָאו, שֶׁהֵם תָּמְכֵי אוֹרַיְתָא'). תמכי אוריתא IS a bechina of וא"ו (same equating proof). לב IS a bechina of וא"ו ('וָאו, עַל שֵׁם: וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנוֹת' — the heart receives and meditates, like the stream/vav). 'והגות לבי תבונות' IS a bechina of וא"ו (directly stated). נחל הנמשך מן המעין IS a bechina of בינה ('וּבִינָה הוּא נַחַל הַנִּמְשָׁךְ מִן הַמַּעְיָן'). The essential shared nature: the extended stream of divine overflow, the receptive letter/vessel that receives illumination from the point (נקדה/יוד). The lev, Israel, Binah, the Tablets, the world — all are the 'vav,' the elongated flowing channel that receives from the spring.

packages.label: מְלָאפוּם — פֶּה מָלֵא, יוֹסֵף הַשַּׁלִּיט, נְקֻדָּה עִם וָאו
packages.label_en: Mela'fum — The Full Mouth, Joseph the Ruler, Point-with-Vav
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the complete union of yud and vav — the full vessel of divine abundance. מלאפום IS a bechina of נקדה עם וא"ו ('מְלָאפוּם הוּא בְּחִינַת נְקֻדָּה עִם וָאו'). 'ויוסף הוא השליט' IS a bechina of מלאפום ('וְיוֹסֵף הוּא הַשַּׁלִּיט, הוּא בְּחִינַת מְלָאפוּם' — Joseph the ruler embodies the full-mouth state). 'הרחב פיך ואמלאהו' IS a bechina of מלאפום ('"הַרְחֶב פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ", זֶה בְּחִינַת מְלָאפוּם'). עשרת הדברות עם הלוחות IS a bechina of מלאפום ('עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדִּבְּרוֹת עִם הַלּוּחוֹת, הוּא בְּחִינַת מְלָאפוּם' — the Ten Commandments+Tablets together = yud+vav = the full-mouth/abundance). 'צדיק מושל' IS a bechina of מלא פום ('"צַדִּיק מוֹשֵׁל" שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מְלֹא פוּם'). מלא פום and מלאפום are the same concept: מלאפום literally means 'מלא פום' (full mouth) — the vowel-sign mela'fum = full mouth of God's abundance filling the tzaddik's speech. The essential shared nature of this package: the combined state of yud and vav in fullness — the ruler whose mouth is completely filled with divine overflow, enabling him to draw abundance to Israel. This is distinct from Package 1 (just the yud/point) and Package 2 (just the vav/stream) — Package 3 is the integrated state of both together.

merge_notes.reason: מלאפום and מלא פום appear as distinct node_ids in the dataset but name the same concept: מלאפום (the vowel-sign holam-vav) literally means מלא פום (full mouth). The Torah text makes this identity explicit: 'הַמְּלָאפוּם הוּא הָאוֹתִיּוֹת מְלֹא פוּם' (section ג). The edge connecting 'צדיק מושל' to מלא פום (id 1809) and the cluster of edges connecting to מלאפום (ids 1811-1813, 2194) are two faces of the same dataset entry. Both node_ids are merged into this package under the dominant node מלאפום. Merge criterion: SHARED NATURE — they are the same concept under two different spellings/presentations in the dataset.

packages.label: קְדֻשַּׁת הַחֶסֶד — יְסוֹד, אַהֲבָה שֶׁבְּדַעַת, חֲסָדִים שֶׁבַּגּוּף
packages.reason: All nodes in this merged package share the essential nature of the holy chesed — the divine love in its pure, unbroken form. יסוד דאצילות IS a bechina of 'צדיק יסוד עולם' ('בִּיסוֹד דַּאֲצִילוּת, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת: צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם'). The Torah explicitly states that after the breaking of the vessels, 'הָאוֹר הַחֶסֶד נִשְׁאָר בִּיסוֹד דַּאֲצִילוּת' — the light of chesed remained in yesod. שרש החסדים שבדעת IS a bechina of אהבה שבדעת ('שֹּׁרֶשׁ הַחֲסָדִים שֶׁבְּדַעַת, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת אַהֲבָה שֶׁבְּדַעַת'). חסדים שבגוף IS a bechina of כלליות המדות ('הַחֲסָדִים שֶׁבְּגוּף, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כְּלָלִיּוּת הַמִּדּוֹת, שֶׁבְּכֻלָּם מְלֻבָּשִׁים חֲסָדִים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת אַהֲבָה'). The three sub-clusters (CC-E: yesod/chesed-preserved; CC-G: root-of-chesed-in-da'at/love-in-da'at; CC-H: chesed-embodied/midot) are all expressions of the same essential reality: holy chesed/love in its pure, preserved, holy form — as opposed to the fallen/broken chesed of Package 5. All three are the domain of 'אוֹר הַחֶסֶד' — the light of chesed that did not fall.

merge_notes.reason: Three raw connected components are merged here: CC-E (יסוד דאצילות + 'צדיק יסוד עולם'), CC-G (שרש החסדים שבדעת + אהבה שבדעת), and CC-H (חסדים שבגוף + כלליות המדות). All three are 2-node components (small, per the merge rule). Merge criterion: SHARED NATURE, not eitza. CC-E's essential nature: the yesod/tzaddik is the repository of the light of chesed that remained after the breaking of the vessels ('אוֹר הַחֶסֶד נִשְׁאָר בִּיסוֹד דַּאֲצִילוּת'). CC-G's essential nature: the root of chesed within da'at IS ahavah-within-da'at — both are the inner quality of holy love at the level of knowing. CC-H's essential nature: the chesed embedded throughout the body IS the totality of the midot — both describe the all-pervasive holy love. All three sub-clusters describe the same domain: holy chesed/ahavah in its pure, preserved form — the positive counterpart to the fallen-chesed of Package 5 (חרפה/ערלה/אהבה נפולה). The merge is justified by shared essential nature: all are expressions of 'אוֹר הַחֶסֶד' — the holy light of divine love that was not broken or fallen.

packages.label: חֶרְפָּה וְעָרְלַת לֵב — הָאַהֲבָה הַנְּפוּלָה
packages.label_en: Shame and Foreskin of the Heart — Fallen Love
packages.reason: All nodes in this component share the essential nature of the fallen, broken chesed — love that has collapsed from its holy source into its negative, obstructing form. חרפה IS a bechina of אהבה נפולה ('וְהוּא בְּחִינַת אַהֲבָה נְפוּלָה וּשְׁבוּרָה, כִּי יָדוּעַ שֶׁהַיֵּצֶר הָרָע וְהַקְּלִפּוֹת נִתְהַוִּים מִן שְׁבִירַת כֵּלִים'). חרפה IS a bechina of ערלה ('וְחֶרְפָּה הוּא בְּחִינַת עָרְלָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: כִּי חֶרְפָּה הִוא לָנוּ'). The essential shared nature: these three nodes are the single evil domain of this Torah — the 'ערלת לב' (foreskin of the heart), which is the clogging/blocking of the heart by fallen love. When the vessels of chesed broke, the light of love fell into the lower realms and became inverted — producing shame/disgrace (חרפה), blockage (ערלה), and disordered love (אהבה נפולה). These are the three faces of the same negative reality: the holy chesed of Package 4 when it falls and inverts. This is the evil mirror of Package 4: just as Package 4 represents holy chesed preserved in yesod, Package 5 represents the same chesed when it has fallen into the klipot.
